PHI.head: Philadelphia has their work cut out
PHI.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Philadelphia is playing for the second night in a row, and Philadelphia has home ice. Philadelphia could still pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks, but they might need a miracle.

CAR.head: A big edge for Carolina
CAR.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Philadelphia is playing for the second night in a row, and Philadelphia has home ice. Philadelphia’s only real way in is pouncing on loose pucks, and they would need a near-perfect night.

story.head: Round two in Philadelphia
paras: The Hurricanes already came to Philadelphia once this season and left with a 3-2 overtime win. The Flyers haven’t won in six. The Hurricanes have won three straight, the last a 7-2 rout of Vancouver.
The Hurricanes shoot a lot, and the Flyers give up plenty. Expect plenty of hitting.
